name: F# port
line: Campfire in F#, translated from the Rust port
question: What if an AI-built F# port could match the Rust port of Basecamp's Campfire byte for byte, and then beat it?
body: A full port of ONCE Campfire to F# on ASP.NET Core and Falco, translated from Basecamp's Rust port by phased agent workflows and checked against it: every parity screen identical, golden vectors and differentials passing, a drop-in for existing installs. Tuned to 1.24-1.33x the throughput of the Rust port it was translated from. Basecamp's Rust has since added full-page caching and now leads it.
alt: F# port: F# throughput climbing past the Rust port it was translated from
